title: 1980 AHSME Problem 14
statement: If \(c\) is a constant and the function \(f\) defined by \[ \begin{gathered} f(x)=\frac{cx}{2x+3},\\ x\ne-\frac32, \end{gathered} \] satisfies \(f(f(x))=x\) for all real numbers \(x\) except \(-\frac32,\) then \(c\) is

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: not uniquely determined by the given information

solutions.text:
Direct composition gives \[ f(f(x)) =\frac{c^2x}{(2c+6)x+9}. \] For this to equal \(x\) identically, the denominator must be the constant \(c^2.\) Thus \(2c+6=0\) and \(c^2=9,\) both of which give \(c=-3.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is A.
hints: Compute \(f(f(x))\) as a single rational expression
For the result to equal \(x\) identically, compare the coefficient of \(x\) in the denominator
